This Dealership is not worth the name it represents.  This is my second bad experience with them when it cones to service. I made an appointment for 9:30 am to drop  my car off for a tune up and for them to also look at the transmission and call me back with the quote and no one ever called.  I finally called at 4pm and the operator said sorry ma'am your advisor is already gone for the day. Wow! How professional is this they haven't done anything on my Tahoe since I dropped it off and the sad part I purchased my Tahoe from them. To me they feel like since I'm  a minority I don't matter, I guess the color of your skin speaks volume when it comes to this Dealership. I would never recommend or purchase any product from this dealership again.  The name needs to change from Friendly because there is nothing Friendly about them only when they're trying to sell you a car.  I will be reaching out to the news cast and voicing my opinion and expose these people for tge bad customer service and fraud.

They kept our vehicle for more than 3 months, with very little communication. Every time we did hear back about our step van, it was a different problem than before. I believe that their technician did not know what they were doing, and caused more harm than they fixed. A few months later and I am having trouble with my vehicle again, and since I do not trust this shop I dig into the problem myself only to find: my wiring harness resting on the exhaust manifold, ground bolts not tightened down, brackets laying off to the side, and wires strewn about outside of the protective conduit. If you want good honest work done by a "certified" shop, then do not bring it to Friendly Fleet.

Today was a blessed experience is buying a Truck God brought me to this place not once but twice for a reason Mishlyn and Alfonso was amazing with the whole process and worked until i was pleased... Go to Tricolor and ask for them...

Save your time and money. Fix it your self. Or take it to industrial power house. Trucks of ours have sat here for two weeks at a time without a proper diag. Called isuzu service care center, and by some miracle, our truck is fixed or towed …

Came to this place to buy some Nice used Tires (mounted and balanced ) for a great price . I noticed they where taking longer than usual to install wheels. A Month later I had a flat , to my surprise the Inatallers at the shop had STRIPPED most of lug  nuts not only on One wheel but the ENTIRE SET by OVER TORQUING with the Gun !

They're quick and efficient. Get you in and out with the best prices in the area. Been coming here for a few years now. Haven't had any issues at all with their service. I highly recommend if you need new or used tires or just a quick patch or plug.
It's the best tire shop and auto inspection I've been to for the past couple of years and I'll be back again for their great customer service.

In and out in less than 30 minutes with 4 tires balanced and mounted. I was the first one there, then two other cars pulled in everyone was attended to quickly. Highly recommended. Well lit, safe, clean shop. Great work and good price!

Usually only takes a few minutes to get work done here and their prices are great. Unlike large shops that usually have one person doing the work leaving you sitting around for over an hour, they have two or three people working on your car to knock it out immediately. Rarely ever a wait because of it.
